newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: REVIEW OF FORECASTS - Australia goods/services balance.
newsitem.headline: REVIEW OF FORECASTS - Australia goods/services balance.

text.p: Australia releases data on the March balance of international trade in goods and services at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) Wednesday.
Forecasts for the figure centre on a surplus of A$150 million, and range from a deficit of A$150 million to a surplus of A$550 million.
This would represent a deterioration from the A$336 million surplus in February, with some weakness expected in exports as a correction to their 14.4 percent rise over the past three months.
